full_judgment: 2. In a nutshell the prosecution case is that on an application made by P.W. 2 Nazimuddin Mollah on 1.10.81, to the District Anti-Corruption Bureau, Kushtia, P.W. 1 Abdul Gafur Sheikh, Inspector, attached to that office, seized the Kabala deed No. 4724 dated 14.12.57 and a power of attorney dated 29.7.55, from the court of Mr. S. A. Ashraf, Magistrate, First Class, Meherpur, in which these documents were filed by the accused persons in connection with C.R. Case No. 695/C/8. After preliminary inquiry, he lodged F.I.R. with Kushtia P.S. against these 3 accused-appellants and one Sahera Khatun on the allegations that on the strength of the power of attorney executed in India by Umapada and others appellant Faraj Ali executed the kabala in favour of the 2 other appellants and Sahera in respect of certain lands. Subsequently, they forged the kabala by incorporating therein some other land that is plot No. 835 appertaining to Khatian No. 868 with an area of '98 acre of mouza Sonapur under P.S. Mehrepur Which actually belonged to P.W. 2 Nazimuddin. After completion of investigation, P.W.1 submitted charge sheet against the 4 accused persons namely in the F.I.R. under sections 467/468/471/420/34 of the Penal Code.
